spans.s: Strong, powerful, mighty, intense, excessive, very much.
Much, very much, exceedingly, intensely, violently, excessively, in a high degree, greatly; तमवेक्ष्य रुरोद सा भृशम्
In a better or superior manner. -Comp. -कोपन a. highly choleric or irascible. -दण्ड a. inflicting severe punishment; स्वराष्ट्रे न्यायवृत्तः स्याद्भृशदण्डश्च शत्रुषु
. -दुःखित, पीडित a. exceedingly afflicted. -संहृष्ट a. very much delighted.
भृशायते [bhṛśāyatē], Den. Ā. To become powerful or strong.
भृश् [bhṛś], 4 P. (भृश्यति) To fall down; see भ्रंश्.

भृष्ट [bhṛṣṭa], p. p. [भ्रस्ज्-क्त] Fried, roasted, parched. -Comp. -अन्नम् rice boiled and fried, -तण्डुलः parched rice; सुगन्धिः कफहा रूक्षः पित्तलो भृष्टतण्डुलः Rājanighaṇṭu. -यवाः (pl.) parched rice.
